name: Asmongold
role: American streamer and YouTuber (Zack Hoyt, born 1990)
summary: Asmongold is a streamer who moved from gaming commentary to political commentary. In 2020 and 2024 he took a political compass quiz on stream, giving mostly socially liberal and market-regulation answers, while in 2025-26 his quoted remarks favor hardline immigration enforcement and a more authoritarian Trump. His documented political record is thin and spread across stream commentary.

regulate-corporations.rationale: On the 2024 quiz he strongly agreed that corporations cannot be trusted to protect the environment voluntarily and need regulation, that the government should penalise businesses that mislead the public, and that a genuine free market requires restrictions. He also said government, not firms, should enforce workplace safety.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Called himself a 'massive free market advocate' while saying a free market only lasts under government oversight; agreed (not strongly) that the freer the market the freer the people.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Disagreed that land should not be bought and sold, saying of course people should be able to own land.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Agreed that protectionism is sometimes necessary in trade, in both quiz videos, citing low-wage competition.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Said he agrees with scaling (progressive) taxes and disagreed that the rich are too highly taxed.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Disagreed that the rich are too highly taxed and said he would pay more tax if required, but he did not call for significantly higher rates.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Said everyone should have access to a standard of medical care, and that the problem is that poor people lack medical care; he did not discuss a specific system.

abortion-legal.rationale: Strongly disagreed that abortion should always be illegal, citing rape and fatal fetal illness. A Wikipedia summary says he supports a constitutional right to abortion; in 2020 he said he did not care much about the issue.

public-service-media.rationale: Said he agreed (85-95%) with the quiz item that no broadcasting institution, however independent, should receive public funding, because those funded are accountable to government; allowed some exceptions outside news.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Disagreed that different sorts of people should keep to their own kind, in both quiz videos.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Strongly agreed that possessing marijuana for personal use should not be an offence (he said he does not use it); the quiz item covers marijuana only.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Disagreed that people with serious inheritable disabilities should not be allowed to reproduce, asking who would decide; chat called the item eugenics.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Strongly disagreed that there are no savage and civilized peoples, only different cultures; said there are inferior cultures. Consistent with his October 2024 remark about Palestinians that drew a Twitch ban.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Rejected the quiz item that charity is better than social security for helping the genuinely disadvantaged.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Strongly disagreed that his child's school should instil religious values; said he does not want religion in school at all.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Said he wants no religion in school at all, which implies opposition to teaching creationism; he was not asked about creationism.

more-religion-public.rationale: Said you can be moral without religion and wants no religion in schools; no direct statement on religion's public role.

premarital-sex.rationale: Strongly disagreed that sex outside marriage is usually immoral.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Agreed a same-sex couple in a stable relationship should not be excluded from adoption ('sure, why not'); did not address marriage directly.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Strongly agreed that what consenting adults do in private is none of the state's business and rejected the idea that gay people are a danger to kids.

restrict-pornography.rationale: In 2020 he strongly disagreed that pornography between consenting adults should be illegal; in 2024 his spoken answer was unclear and he also said sex is over-present in culture.

harm-principle.rationale: Said his approach is that you can do what you want unless you hurt others, with a very high bar for intervening in self-harm; also said some behaviour that makes someone a drag on society might merit attention.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Disagreed that mothers' first duty is to be homemakers, saying it depends on the couple and many single mothers must work.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Disagreed that his race has superior qualities and said group statistics on IQ or height dehumanise people and he finds that thinking unhealthy; no direct statement on genetics.

death-penalty.rationale: Disagreed with the quiz item that the death penalty should be an option for the most serious crimes, citing appeal costs and due process, while saying he would privately like some criminals shot.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Strongly disagreed that only wrongdoers need worry about surveillance; agreed civil liberties are curbed in the name of counter-terrorism.

rehabilitation.rationale: Strongly disagreed that punishment should matter more than rehabilitation, but also said rehabilitating some criminals is a waste of time.

empower-police-military.rationale: Called himself a very big police supporter (2024); in 2026 said he favors using the National Guard and military to round up immigrants.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Describes himself as a strong police supporter and said incorrigible criminals should simply be confined until they die.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Said violence is acceptable in self-defence, and strongly agreed with 'an eye for an eye', including military force.

basic-income.rationale: A Wikipedia summary says he supports universal basic income; in 2024 he argued unemployment cannot be controlled as automation grows and the concern should be people's survival.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Said many jobs will be automated within decades and people should not expect to need jobs.

universal-morality.rationale: A Wikipedia summary reports he calls himself a moral nihilist, describing morality as ideas imposed by elites.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Media Matters quotes him (2025-26) calling for denaturalization, using the National Guard and military to round up immigrants, and voting for whoever will be tougher.

open-borders.rationale: His quoted 2026 statements favor mass removal of immigrants and a harsher regime, which is incompatible with open borders.

strong-leader.rationale: Said on 25 Aug 2025 that he does not like that Trump is not more authoritarian; separately said one-party efficiency is real but a giant downside.

notes: Quiz answers (2020, 2024) and later stream quotes (2025-26) sit uneasily together, for example on authoritarianism and one-party rule; later quotes come via Media Matters, a critical outlet, so only verbatim dated quotes were used. Quiz answers were read from auto-captions and are sometimes jokes or hedged; unclear ones were left null. Where the 2020 and 2024 runs differed (international law, pornography, openness about sex, work requirements) the item was left null or low confidence.
